fields.title: Write the Section
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Feature: a buyer can share a shopping list with another person via a link. Write the section covering seven points.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: data — new 'Shared List' entity with a link; opening it shows items, but not name, address, or past order amounts. Basis — consent, user action. Minimization — we do not store who opened the link. Storage — 30 days from creation. Account deletion — lists are deleted, links stop working. Access — anyone with the link, hence the identifier is unguessable and link revocation is available. Threats — triage triggers (communication between users), review needed: link enumeration, disclosure via forwarding, search engine indexing.
